input_evidence: Immutable preregistered daily-modality-outage artifact whose independent_audit.json status must be PASSED

ALWAYS_EXPOSE_NORMAL.affected_rows: Expose the recovery-arm probability and label the forecast NORMAL despite the declared outage.
ALWAYS_EXPOSE_NORMAL.unaffected_rows: Expose the recovery-arm probability and label NORMAL.

ABSTAIN_ON_DECLARED_OUTAGE.affected_rows: Do not expose a probability; status ABSTAIN with the declared missing modality/duration as reason.
ABSTAIN_ON_DECLARED_OUTAGE.unaffected_rows: Expose the same recovery-arm probability and label NORMAL.

EXPOSE_DEGRADED_ON_DECLARED_OUTAGE.affected_rows: Expose the same recovery-arm probability but label DEGRADED with the declared missing modality/duration as reason.
EXPOSE_DEGRADED_ON_DECLARED_OUTAGE.unaffected_rows: Expose the same recovery-arm probability and label NORMAL.

affected_row_definition: Exactly the union of the preregistered outage block intervals projected onto score-role issue times. It does not depend on labels, predictions, hidden-cell count or outcome favorability.

matched_coverage_comparison.rule: For each scenario and recovery arm, evaluate ALWAYS_EXPOSE_NORMAL and EXPOSE_DEGRADED_ON_DECLARED_OUTAGE on exactly the non-affected rows exposed by ABSTAIN_ON_DECLARED_OUTAGE. This matched-row result is reported only to show what selection alone does; it cannot replace the whole-cohort result.

full_cohort_reporting.abstention_rule: An abstained positive is counted as lost positive coverage and in coverage_adjusted_missed_positives; it may not be removed from the denominator.

degraded_policy_interpretation: DEGRADED is an auditable status, not a learned probability correction. This avoids inventing an outcome-tuned shrinkage rule after inspecting outage results.
selection_rule: Report all 3 modalities x 3 durations x 3 recovery arms x 2 frozen thresholds x 3 handling policies. Omit none based on outcomes.
claim_boundary: Development-only handling-policy diagnostic on already-inspected score identities. It can quantify coverage, missed-event and false-alert tradeoffs but cannot establish operator benefit, prospective causality, locked-test robustness, operational readiness or superiority.
